claims.identity_match_assessment: Confirmed by exact-name, exact-rank, protected-identifier agreement between two official records, plus an official OSS mission history.
claims.temporal_assessment: The official citation covers August 1944 through April 1945; a separate source supports the 1943 recruitment sequence.
claims.match_notes: The full protected identifier remains private and is not reproduced in public evidence text.

claims.identity_match_assessment: Official Marine Corps records independently confirm the exact indexed person and his OSS Union II service.
claims.temporal_assessment: The recruitment narrative explicitly links the instructor assignment to OSS recruitment during 1943.
claims.match_notes: Published as a qualified immediate military assignment; it is not a civilian-employer claim.
